plan.title: Select Existing Closed RFQ for Recreate Order

steps.note: Open the Events list where the Live, History, Drafts, and Recurring tabs are available.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully before selecting an existing event.

Open the first historical event whose card identifies it as an RFQ.
Verify the selected event displays a closed status badge.
Read and verify the selected event's title for the test data.
Verify that the closed RFQ has at least one vendor response/bid.
